correctness.rationale: Every finite incidence class of size at most 5 corresponds to exactly one nondecreasing tuple of masks 1..7. Every single-edge addition corresponds to one zero-bit edit. The saved verifier independently recomputes all 1,284 reliability coefficient vectors for 341 eligible structures; for all nonexceptions it checks coefficientwise optimality. Exactly six exceptions equal one plant-symmetry orbit; their five possible coefficient vectors permit only two undominated options. Exact algebra gives p^2(1-p)(1-3p), proving the unique interior crossover. No claims for larger networks.

value.rationale: The two-partner service condition directly models a stringent form of redundancy motivated by plant-pollinator robustness and documented concerns about functional versus topological redundancy. For a single-link intervention, the result identifies the first feasible network size with survival-dependent action ranking and completely classifies that layer. The exact threshold 1/3 matters for robustness decisions under uncertainty, and unlike a random small count it is minimal and exhaustive. No field prediction or all-size claim is made.
